verdict.rationale: The pack only touches the edges of this story. New Relic's CLI can record APM deployment markers, which covers release tracking, and alerts can flag signals that show abnormal behavior, which loosely approximates regression detection. Nothing in the evidence documents grouping errors into issues or viewing stack traces, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: error grouping into issues, stack trace views, regression detection tied to releases, independent or hands-on corroboration.
